title: Checks for wildcard dependencies in the Cargo.toml.
summary: As the edition guide says, it is highly unlikely that you work with any possible version of your dependency, and wildcard dependencies would cause unnecessary breakage in the ecosystem. Clippy puts this lint in the cargo group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for wildcard enum matches using _.
summary: New enum variants added by library updates can be missed. Clippy puts this lint in the restriction group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for wildcard imports use _::*.
summary: wildcard imports can pollute the namespace. This is especially bad if you try to import something through a wildcard, that already has been imported by name from a different source: Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for wildcard pattern used with others patterns in same match arm.
summary: Wildcard pattern already covers any other pattern as it will match anyway. It makes the code less readable, especially to spot wildcard pattern use in match arm. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for calls to with_capacity(0) on standard library collections and types.
summary: Calling with_capacity(0) does not allocate any initial capacity and behaves identically to new(). Using new() is more idiomatic, concise, and is a const fn for these types. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.
